name: Bounty Hunter (Scout Archetype)
body:
Wherever there are bounties to be claimed, there are always those who will come to claim them.

Bring ‘em Back Alive (Ex)

It is very important for a bounty hunter to be able to cash in on their marks. At 1st level, a bounty hunter can choose to do non-lethal damage with any weapon with which they are proficient without penalty. In addition whenever the bounty hunter makes a non-lethal sneak attack they roll d8s instead of d6s.

This ability modifies sneak attack.

Mark (Ex)

Bounty hunters take contracts or follow independent leads with steadfast determination. At 1st level, they can focus on a single creature and gain a number of bonuses to aid in its capture. To mark a creature the bounty hunter must have a reliable description or image of the creature that marks it as unique in some way. After receiving such a description they must quietly focus for 1 minute, after which they gain the following benefits as long as they have at least 1 grit point. A bonus equal to 1/2 their bounty hunter level on Diplomacy checks to gather information about their marks and on Perception and Survival checks to see or track their mark. A bounty hunter may also spend 1 grit point as a swift action to gain a bonus on attack rolls against their mark equal to their Wisdom modifier for one minute.

While the mark is active the bounty hunter also adds their character level to weapon damage dealt to their mark.

This ability replaces trapfinding and one deed of the bounty hunter’s choice normally gained at 1st level.

Crippling Strike (Ex)

Bounty hunters learn to efficiently slow the reflexes and defenses of their marks. At 7th level, whenever the bounty deals sneak attack damage they may spend 1 grit point as a swift action to deal 2 Dexterity damage to the creature.

This ability replaces two deeds of the bounty hunter’s choice normally gained at 7th level.

Track the Unseen (Su)

At 10th level, the bounty hunter gains the ability to track their marks even while the mark is benefiting from pass without trace or similar magic, though at a -10 penalty.

This ability replaces astounding grit.

Hunter’s Dedication (Ex)

At 12th level, as long as the bounty hunter has at least 1 grit, they gain a bonus on Will saves equal to their Constitution modifier against spells and abilities originating from their mark.

This ability replaces the combat feat normally gained at 12th level.
